title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented study settings in and around Reeves Library, from reservable rooms to quiet seating and media-production space.

cards.title: Reeves Library
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Start at the reference desk, then choose a table, carrel, lounge seat, group area, or study room based on the work you need to finish.
cards.short_summary: A central library building with multiple documented study formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian states that Reeves Library provides study tables, individual carrels, group study areas, lounge seating, and study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Located at the heart of North Campus; use the library’s current hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Reeves Library Glass Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library, main floor
cards.notes: Use the glass rooms when your session benefits from a door, whiteboard, and movable tables and chairs; coordinate with collaborators before settling in.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed library rooms configured for individual or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian documents glass study spaces in Reeves Library with whiteboards and movable tables and chairs for students to meet, collaborate, and study.
cards.access_notes: The source places these rooms in Reeves Library; availability is not stated, so confirm locally.

cards.title: Reeves Library Individual Carrels
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library
cards.notes: Choose an individual carrel for a more self-contained reading or writing session, and ask library staff if you need help locating a suitable seat.
cards.short_summary: Individual workstations among Reeves Library’s study options.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian lists individual carrels among the study spaces available at Reeves Library.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies carrels as library study space; it does not specify assignment rules for standard carrels.

cards.title: Reeves Library Group Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library
cards.notes: Bring your project group to the library’s designated group-study seating and plan your materials before you arrive so the work session can begin promptly.
cards.short_summary: Shared seating areas intended for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian lists group study areas as part of Reeves Library’s study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Reeves Library; no reservation procedure is stated for these open group areas.

cards.title: Reeves Library Lounge Seating
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library
cards.notes: Use the lounge seating when you want a less desk-like place to read or review; keep headphones handy if your task needs quiet focus.
cards.short_summary: Library lounge seating offered alongside tables and carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian lists lounge seating among the study spaces at Reeves Library.
cards.access_notes: Located in Reeves Library; the source does not identify a particular floor or availability rules.

cards.title: REEVE 212 Group Study Classroom
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library
cards.notes: For a group session that needs a defined room, look up REEVE 212 in the University’s 25Live booking system before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A group-study classroom listed as reservable through 25Live.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian’s Reeves Library portal lists REEVE 212 as a group study classroom available through 25Live room bookings.
cards.access_notes: Listed in 25Live room bookings; consult that system for current reservation eligibility and availability.

cards.title: REEVE 315 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library
cards.notes: Book REEVE 315 when your group needs a television for shared viewing, and verify the reservation details in 25Live before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group-study room with a television.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian’s Reeves Library portal lists REEVE 315 as a group study room with television available through 25Live room bookings.
cards.access_notes: Listed in 25Live room bookings; consult that system for current reservation eligibility and availability.

cards.title: Zinczenko New Media Center
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library, lower level
cards.notes: Use this named media-creation space when an assignment involves audio, video, digital, or print work; confirm room scheduling before a production session.
cards.short_summary: A library media center combining a study lounge with media creation.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian identifies the Zinczenko New Media Center in Reeves Library as a study lounge and media-creation space.
cards.access_notes: Listed through 25Live as REEVE ZNMC; check that system for current scheduling details.

cards.title: Debra Gaspar Reading Nook
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library north bay window-seat area
cards.notes: Take a reading assignment to the nook near the children’s section, where comfortable seating, window cushions, and a bestseller shelf are documented.
cards.short_summary: A named, comfortable reading area in the library’s north bay.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian describes the Debra Gaspar Reading Nook in Reeves Library’s north bay window-seat area with comfortable seating, custom cushions, and a bookshelf.
cards.source_title: Debra Gaspar Reading Nook | Moravian University
cards.access_notes: Located by the children’s section in Reeves Library; use current library hours when planning a visit.

cards.entity_name: Reeves Library Lower-Level Digital Collaboration Space
cards.title: Reeves Library Digital Collaboration Space
cards.subtitle: Reeves Library, lower level
cards.notes: Set up a multimodal project here when you need screen sharing, movable furniture, movable whiteboards, or a recording studio nearby.
cards.short_summary: A flexible lower-level setting for collaborative digital projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian states that Reeves Library’s lower level has digital collaboration spaces with screen-sharing monitors, movable furniture, and movable whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s lower level; the source does not state reservation or access requirements.
